data.narrative:
Reverion is a Series B climate and energy technology company that has raised $79M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers—KoBold Metals ($3.0B Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B Series C), and Amogy ($700M Series C)—alongside one public comparable and eight additional private references in the broader climate tech landscape.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy base and applying a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, yields $150M. Peer-median valuation, calculated across the three identified comparables, produces $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. These methods reflect different assumptions about capital deployment efficiency and market multiples at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $128M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $575M. The dispersion reflects uncertainty in whether Reverion's technology maturity and addressable market align more closely with early-stage capital deployment patterns or with the higher-valuation cohort represented by Series C-stage peers. Key uncertainties include the company's revenue generation trajectory, technical risk mitigation since last funding, and sector-level capital availability for Climate & Energy infrastructure plays.
